The format of this print-out: For each PO, x:a b=c+d+e, where 
- x is the time-frame counting back from the PO
- a is the total number of registers in the COI of the PO so far
- b is the number of registers in the COI of the PO in this time-frame
- c is the number of registers in b that are new (appear for the first time)
- d is the number of registers in b in common with the previous time-frame
- e is the number of registers in b in common with other time-frames
